source_review.notes: Reviewed the original rope paper and Crowley text-sequence study; current VS Code piece-tree account/source, Xi metrics/text-engine notes, Ropey API, Unicode UAX #29/#14, and the current GNU Emacs manual-source mirror. All ten final destinations returned HTTP 200. The legacy archive contained no rope or piece-table chapter suitable for reuse.

Qualified every length/index claim by bytes, Unicode scalars, UTF-16 units, graphemes, lines, or the declared abstract metric.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The text explicitly separates storage coordinates from user-perceived graphemes and display columns.

evidence: Replayed hello-world insertion at five, deletion [15,20), and insertion at 15.
Confirmed final escaped text hello, durable editor\n, five pieces, 15 add units, original unchanged, two lines, and invariant true.
Recomputed the exercise one/two descriptor ranges: O length 8, A insertion length 7, delete [11,14), retained O[0:3], O[3:4], and O[7:8].
Checked binary-rope navigation with left metric eight maps index eleven to right-local index three.
numerical_recomputation.notes: ASCII fixtures make Python scalar and byte offsets coincide only in the finite executable evidence.

evidence: Verified flatten recursively preserves left-before-right sequence and that metric composition follows the same order.
Derived rope lookup, split, concat, insertion, and deletion from flattening and left metrics.
Derived piece insertion/deletion as source-range partitions and omission; verified legal coalescing preserves flattening.
Checked that logarithmic claims explicitly require O(log N) height plus bounded leaf work and restoration of balance/chunk rules.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No generic tree node, balance scheme, or deferred normalization policy is assumed to have the same worst-case bound.

evidence: Reviewed empty, one-past-end insertion, empty range, entire deletion/replacement, every piece/leaf boundary, zero-length removal, checked start+length, and maximum metrics.
Reviewed unbalanced chains, oversized/tiny chunks, alternating distant edits, repeated same-point inserts, piece explosion, coalescing, allocation failure, and compaction.
Reviewed UTF-8 interior offsets, scalar/UTF-16/grapheme differences, malformed input policy, CR/LF/CRLF split across chunks, mixed endings, trailing breaks, and enormous lines.
Reviewed stale versions, anchor bias, simultaneous edits, retained snapshots/undo, save partial failure/external conflict, and recovery nonclaims.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary-sensitive metrics are required to carry enough cross-child state rather than treating all counts as independent sums.

evidence: Checked executable pieces use known sources, positive lengths, in-bounds half-open ranges, no adjacent coalescible same-source ranges, and flattened/logical length agreement.
Checked each trace edit preserves the original buffer and appends rather than rewrites added storage.
Reviewed rope child order, summary equality, balance, leaf bounds, and version immutability obligations.
invariant_checking.notes: The executable list representation intentionally provides no balanced-tree complexity evidence.

evidence: Reviewed rope structural-induction argument from leaves through internal concatenation and ordered metric composition.
Reviewed lookup coordinate subtraction and split/concat preservation, including one-past-end distinction.
Reviewed descriptor partition proofs for insertion/deletion and the source-contiguity premise for coalescing.
Reviewed version/compaction obligation to preserve flattening/metrics and migrate or invalidate dependent identities.
proof_review.notes: CRLF/grapheme summaries are presented as proof obligations with examples, not as a complete implementation of Unicode segmentation.

evidence: Rope complexity is conditional on named height, chunk, and operation-restoration premises.
Library/project implementation and performance observations are source/version scoped.
Undo, crash recovery, saving, persistence, concurrency, compaction, and deployment remain separate mechanisms/evidence boundaries.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Neither append-only storage nor structural sharing is mislabeled as automatic durability or bounded memory.

evidence: The standard-library Python snippet passed exact seven-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under recorded Python 3.14.4.
It emits evidence=finite_piece_table_trace and is immediately limited against balanced complexity, Unicode, persistence, durability, and editor performance.
All ten final reference destinations and all repository-local links were directly checked.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No production rope/piece tree, Unicode conformance suite, multi-version engine, filesystem failure path, editor corpus benchmark, or compaction migration was empirically evaluated.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the text-buffer contract, coordinate units, rope flattening/balance/chunks/metrics, piece sources/descriptors/tree organization, hybrid boundaries, versions/anchors, lines, saving, compaction, alternatives, and evidence.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed checked source ranges, leaf normalization, relative metrics, CRLF composition, descriptor fragmentation, snapshot retention, undo budgets, stale coordinates, multicursor ordering, encoding/BOM/newlines, external conflicts, atomic-write policy, compaction dependencies, real workloads, memory, and tail latency.

pedagogical_review.notes: Starts with the text ADT and coordinate ambiguity, derives rope and piece-table mechanisms separately, then explains piece-tree composition and lifecycle issues. Provides a reproduced descriptor trace, thirteen causal misconceptions, ten varied examples, and five progressive exercises with complete answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external editor, Unicode, compiler, runtime, allocator, filesystem, database, concurrency, security, reliability, accessibility, localization, operations, architecture, or independent academic review is claimed. The chapter and finite trace prove neither a generic rope/piece-tree implementation, logarithmic complexity without maintained balance/chunk bounds, full Unicode/grapheme/line conformance, iterator/anchor correctness, bounded retention, thread safety, crash recovery, save durability, compaction safety, benchmark superiority, certification, nor deployment fitness.
